map.按体重、年龄与活动度估算日均热量需求与日喂粮量（g）。: Estimate daily calorie needs and daily feed amount (g) from weight, age and activity level.
map.静息能量需求 RER(kcal/天) = 70 × 体重(kg) 的 0.75: Resting energy requirement RER (kcal/day) = 70 × body weight (kg) to the 0.75 power; daily energy requirement DER = RER × factor (juvenile 2.5 to 3.0, neutered adult 1.6, intact adult 1.8, senior 1.2 to 1.4, weight-loss 0.8 to 1.0, weight-gain 1.2 to 1.8); daily feed (g) = DER ÷ energy per gram of feed (kcal/g); feed in 2 to 3 meals and adjust by 10% every 2 to 4 weeks by body-condition score.
map.按宠物体重、年龄、活动量估算每日热量需求，再折算成具体喂食克数，避免过胖或过瘦。: Estimate daily calorie needs from the pet's weight, age and activity, then convert to specific feed grams to avoid over- or under-weight.
map.换粮时根据新粮的 kcal/100g 重新算喂食量，保持热量一致、平稳过渡。: When switching food, recompute the feed amount from the new food's kcal/100g to keep calories consistent and transition smoothly.
map.绝育/减脂期把目标设为“减重”自动下调 10% 热量，增重期上调 10%。: During neutering / fat-loss, set the goal to 'weight loss' to auto-cut 10% of calories; during weight-gain raise by 10%.
map.犬 RMR = 130×体重^0.75 = 130×10^0.75 ≈ 731: Dog RMR = 130×weight^0.75 = 130×10^0.75 ≈ 731 kcal; age factor (adult=1) × activity (1) × RMR = 731 kcal/day. At 400 kcal/100g food, daily ration = 731÷400×100 ≈ 183 g, fed in 2–3 meals.
map.犬和猫的基础代谢系数为什么不同？: Why do dogs and cats have different basal-metabolism coefficients?
map.犬 RMR 系数 130、猫 70（均乘体重的 0.75 次方），反映物种差异；: Dog RMR coefficient 130, cat 70 (both × body weight to the 0.75 power), reflecting species differences; cats have a higher metabolic rate. Juvenile (<1 yr) age factor 2, adult 1, senior (≥7) 0.9.
map.算出来和实际吃的不一样怎么办？: What if the calculation differs from actual intake?
map.公式是理论估值，实际按体重变化与食欲微调 5%–10%；: The formula is a theoretical estimate; in practice fine-tune 5%–10% by weight change and appetite;
map.也要计入每日总额，肥胖宠物优先选低脂粮并增加活动量。: also count into the daily total; for overweight pets prefer low-fat food and increase activity.
